issues.title: Annotated original PDF links bypassed the deferred source menu
issues.sourceEvidence: Original qsource and sharedStatement sourceReference remained unconditional while sourceCopies.subject.afterCorrection and image gates were active.
issues.fix: Root gated individual links with subjectOriginalReady and shared-context links with sharedOriginalReady.

issues.title: A shared annotated image unlocked after validating only its first rendered question
issues.sourceEvidence: The original sharedStatement gate depended only on isCorrected(q), while its context belonged to multiple questions.
issues.fix: sharedOriginalReady now checks every member in QUESTIONS independently of the visible filtered list; subject copies use the same group condition.

issues.title: A failed backup could be followed by overwriting the original progress key
affected: Both profiles in all ten migrated banks when the browser storage quota prevents the backup key
issues.sourceEvidence: The original migration assigned fallbackSessions before creating the backup and returned the migrated object after catching a storage error; save subsequently wrote it directly.
issues.fix: v6PendingBackups plus persistV6Progress gate all later save writes until the original backup is created and verified.

issues.title: Synthetic unsorted selections caused a false runtime persistence failure
issues.sourceEvidence: The suite injected the approved key BDC directly as a selection; actual loadExam normalized the equivalent selection to BCD. Exact string comparison reported a false change.
issues.fix: Root normalized all three synthetic selection injections as the UI does; the approved key and release file remained unchanged.

residualLimits: No graphical browser verification is claimed; JavaScript tests use Node VM and the DOM adapter.
Semantic detection of unflagged image annotations depends on the nine independent documentary reviews.

Pixel equality was checked for 30 specified samples by the main integrity suite; all 6383 capture files were decoded and all 6762 crop-reference geometries checked, but no exhaustive individual visual review is claimed by this integration audit.

additionalVerifiedChanges.change: Real compilation filename displayed; panel descriptions preserved in sourceLabel; pages grouped by source document.
